meta.title: BBA in Marketing, Finance & Business Analytics | Atlas
meta.description: Study BBA in marketing, finance, and analytics at Atlas ISME — combining bba marketing and finance skills for a versatile management career in Mumbai.

hero.title:
BBA (Hons.) Majoring in Marketing/Finance
/Business Analytics
hero.lead: ATLAS BBA (Hons.) is built for future founders, brand leaders, and finance pros who want more than just a degree — they want an edge.

panes.label: Overview
text: The BBA (Hons.) in Marketing at ATLAS ISME is designed to nurture creative, strategic, and data-savvy marketers who can shape brands and drive growth in a dynamic global marketplace. The program builds strong foundations in

text.strong: consumer psychology, digital strategy, brand management, and marketing analytics.
Learning is immersive — through live projects, brand simulations, marketing labs, and masterclasses with industry leaders.

text: Each concept, from consumer insight to digital transformation, is explored through real business challenges. By the end of the program, you’ll

text.strong: be equipped to craft compelling campaigns, lead market strategies, and build brands that inspire

text: — across industries, startups, or your own entrepreneurial journey.

cards.title: Understand markets and consumers to influence business outcomes
Build impactful brands across industries and platforms
Use data and tools to drive high-performing campaigns
Turn insights into strategy that delivers results
Create brand stories that attract and retain customers
Leverage emerging technologies to optimize user experiences and engagement
Finance
cards.text: Master financial concepts like investment, valuation, and budgeting to help organizations grow and thrive. The Finance minor equips you with practical knowledge for careers in corporate finance, banking, and investment management.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Turn your ideas into action by exploring what it takes to launch new ventures or drive innovation within organizations. This minor sharpens your creative thinking, leadership, and problem-solving skills through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Business Analytics
cards.text: Harness the power of data to make smarter business decisions. Learn to analyze trends, visualize information, and use quantitative tools, preparing you to impact marketing, finance, and strategy teams with data-driven insights.

cards.title: Human Resource Management
cards.text: Become an expert in shaping workplace culture. Dive into strategies for hiring, team-building, and employee engagement, gaining hands-on experience to lead people-focused organizations.

cards.title: Supply Chain Management
cards.text: Engineer organizational efficiency by optimizing business processes and managing supply chains. Gain practical skills to improve logistics, streamline workflows, and deliver smooth customer experiences.

cards.title: Economics & Public Policy
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies that affect businesses and markets worldwide. Learn how economic analysis supports better decision-making and how public policy drives innovation and shapes industries.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: This course set covers core management, marketing, finance, and entrepreneurship, integrating AI, Excel, and design thinking, with insights into consumer behavior and Indian psychology for effective decision-making.

courses.title: Principles of Management
courses.text: Explore foundational management concepts, including planning, organizing, leading, and controlling, to effectively run organizations.
Understand marketing strategies and how consumer psychology drives purchasing decisions to create impactful campaigns.

title.strong: Basics of Finance / Design Thinking for Businesses

courses.text: Learn essential financial principles for business decisions, or apply design thinking to innovate and solve business challenges creatively.
Gain insights into starting and managing ventures, developing business models, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset.
Study behavioral patterns, cultural influences, and psychological principles shaping individual and collective decision-making in India.
Develops spreadsheet-based analytical skills for data processing, modelling, and insight generation.
Expands learning with interdisciplinary exposure that supports analytical and managerial growth.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Leadership, analytics, and consumer insights combined with hands-on projects give you skills that outpace traditional classroom learning.
head: Subjects
ATLAS ISME
Other Business Schools
rows: Principles of Management
Introduced in Semester 1 — students explore leadership through planning, organizing, and decision-making simulations.
Usually theoretical, introduced later without early leadership immersion.
Marketing Management & Consumer Behaviour
Focused on real-world campaigns, decoding consumer psychology, and digital-era marketing strategies.
Often limited to traditional marketing models and delayed practical exposure.
Basics of Finance / Design Thinking for Businesses
Choice-based learning — either master financial foundations for business decisions or apply design thinking to creatively solve real problems.
Typically separates finance and creativity, missing cross-disciplinary innovation.
Entrepreneurship Fundamentals
Hands-on startup simulations, business model creation, and problem-solving through real-world case studies.
Textbook-driven approach; little emphasis on building or testing real ventures.
Indian Behavioural Psychology
Unique focus on Indian mindsets, cultural nuances, and behavioral insights shaping business and consumer actions.
Rarely covered; psychology taught from a generic Western perspective.
AI Tools and Excel for Decision Making
Integrated use of AI, Excel, and analytics from Day 1 — turning data into actionable business insights.
Basic Excel training; AI tools introduced much later or not at all.
ATLAS Elective
Practical sustainability in business context.
Basic environmental theory only.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: This set covers digital marketing, finance, innovation, economics, communication, and India’s constitutional framework for navigating modern business effectively.

courses.text: Explore how digital transformation, sustainability, and innovation are reshaping traditional business frameworks for the future economy.
Learn strategies to build and grow brands online using SEO, social media, analytics, and content-driven marketing.

title.strong: Financial Statement Analysis / Systems Thinking for Innovation

courses.text: Understand how to interpret financial data for strategic decision-making, or apply systems thinking to design innovative, interconnected business solutions.
Gain a foundational understanding of market dynamics, economic policies, and their impact on global and local business environments.
Develop strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively express ideas and collaborate in professional settings.

title.strong: Statistics for Business / Creative Thinking & Problem Solving

courses.text: Master data interpretation for business insights, or strengthen creative reasoning to tackle complex challenges with innovative solutions.
Gain real-world experience by applying classroom concepts in a professional setting. Build skills, confidence, and industry exposure.
Understand the key principles, rights, and governance structures shaping India’s constitutional and civic framework.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: This semester strengthens marketing execution and financial compliance capabilities, integrating analytical SEO strategy, managerial accounting, and taxation to support operational business decisions.

courses.text: Build persuasive communication and client management skills through live simulations and market-based negotiation challenges. Students learn how to convert consumer insights into effective sales strategies.
Master the tools and analytics of digital visibility. Students design and monitor live campaigns, learning how SEO and SEM drive brand positioning and measurable marketing ROI.
Introduces costing methods, budgeting, and managerial reporting to support operational decisions.
Provides practical understanding of direct and indirect tax principles, compliance, and basic tax planning.
Teaches research design, data collection, and analysis techniques for evidence-based business decisions.
Offers supervised industry placement to apply marketing and finance concepts in real organisational settings.
Links ecological principles to sustainable business practice and corporate responsibility strategies.

items.title: Sociology
items.text: Explore how societies, cultures, and communities function and influence human behavior. Understand the social forces that shape markets, organizations, and decision-making in the real world.

items.title: Negotiation and Persuation
items.text: Learn strategies to influence, negotiate, and resolve conflicts effectively. Apply practical techniques to achieve results in business and leadership scenarios.

items.title: International Relations
items.text: Understand global politics, diplomacy, and international institutions that impact businesses and markets worldwide. Analyze global trends to make informed strategic decisions.

items.title: Geopolitical Economy
items.text: Study the intersection of economics, politics, and global events. Learn how policy, trade, and geopolitical shifts influence business and market strategy.

items.title: Ancient Philosophy
items.text: Examine timeless ideas on ethics, leadership, and human behavior. Apply philosophical insights to modern management, decision-making, and organizational challenges.

items.title: Product and Service Design
items.text: Learn to create innovative, user-focused products and services. Move from ideation to prototyping and launch with practical frameworks and design thinking.

items.title: Data Visualisation
items.text: Transform raw data into clear, actionable visual insights. Learn to communicate complex information effectively for business decisions.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.text: Understand user behavior and design intuitive digital experiences. Build interfaces and workflows that engage users and meet real business goals.

items.title: ML for Managers
items.text: Gain a practical understanding of machine learning concepts and tools. Learn to apply predictive insights to solve business problems and drive strategy.

items.title: Sports Analytics
items.text: Analyze performance, strategy, and business metrics in sports using data-driven approaches. Translate insights into actionable decisions for teams, organizations, and fans.

items.title: Sustainability & ESG
items.text: Explore environmental, social, and governance practices that drive long-term value. Learn how businesses integrate sustainability into strategy, operations, and impact measurement.
